## Overview

The package ships 19 bundled PSGC snapshots (2022-04-29 … 2026-07-13). You can switch the whole process to an older masterlist with `use_version()`, or query a single snapshot per call with `as_of=` — the per-call form is the thread-safe choice.

## Switch the global version

```python
import barangay

barangay.use_version("2025-07-08")
brgy = barangay.barangays.lookup("1907005010")
barangay.use_version(None)  # back to latest
```

## Per-query historical

### `as_of=` on a single call

`as_of` queries one snapshot without mutating global state — safe inside web servers and concurrent code, where `use_version()` would race:

```python
from barangay import search_fuzzy, validate

results = search_fuzzy("Tongmageng", as_of="2025-07-08")   # queries that snapshot only
v = validate("Tongmageng, Sitangkai, Tawi-Tawi", as_of="2025-07-08")
```

::: {.callout-important title="Per-query beats global in shared processes"}
`Database()` is a process-wide singleton and `use_version()` mutates its active snapshot globally. In a web server or any multi-threaded context, prefer `as_of=` per call. `use_version(None)` restores the latest snapshot.
:::

### `resolve_date()` — closest snapshot

You usually have an arbitrary business date ("what was valid on 2024-06-01?"), not a published PSGC date. [`resolve_date()`](../reference/python-api/utilities.qmd) maps any date to the nearest available snapshot using **backward fill** — the most recent snapshot **at or before** the requested date; if none exists, it falls back to the earliest snapshot:

```python
from barangay import resolve_date, available_dates, current

resolved, message = resolve_date("2024-06-01", available_dates, current)
print(resolved)   # 2024-05-08
print(message)    # Using 2024-05-08 dataset (closest to 2024-06-01)
```

`2024-06-01` sits between the `2024-05-08` and `2024-07-12` snapshots; backward fill picks `2024-05-08`. Feed the resolved date straight into `as_of=`:

```python
results = search_fuzzy("Tongmageng", as_of=resolved)
```

See [`available_dates`](../reference/python-api/utilities.qmd) for the full list of snapshot dates.
